title: Halo Halo Filipino Dessert
description: A refreshing Filipino dessert made with shaved ice and various sweet ingredients, perfect for hot summer days.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the yellow beans, energizing red beans, filipino halo halo toppings, freekeh, and halo.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the evaporated milk, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Pour the milk mixture over the bean mixture and stir well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Just before serving, top with shaved ice and serve immediately.
Serve in tall glasses or bowls and garnish with additional toppings if desired.
